name: Patronus AI
tagline: MCP-Native Agent Eval vs Eval Models and Simulation Infrastructure
oneLine: Develops 'simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI'; also ships eval models Lynx and GLIDER and an eval API.
tldrVendor: Patronus AI today leads with simulation: 'simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI', built on Digital World Models. Its evaluation line remains: Lynx (SOTA hallucination detection model), GLIDER (3B evaluator scoring text on user-defined criteria), Percival (20+ agent failure modes), a usage-priced eval API ($10 per 1k small evaluator calls), toxicity and PII evaluators, and an Enterprise plan with on-prem/VPC deployment and SOC, TISAX and HIPAA badges.

rows.quote: programming language-agnostic, with a Python SDK available for easy integration

rows.vendor: Vendor-hosted API by default; Enterprise plan offers on-prem / dedicated VPC deployment
rows.quote: On-prem / dedicated VPC, custom data retention, SSO.

rows.vendor: Each evaluation is a remote evaluator API call (RemoteEvaluator.evaluate); tracing via @traced decorator + OpenInference
rows.quote: The OpenInference instrumentation automatically adds spans for all OpenAI API calls, capturing prompts, responses, and model parameters without any code changes.
Glider: Powerful 3B evaluator LLM that can score any text input on user-defined criteria

Not stated: No fetched vendor page mentions cost tracking. Looked at: homepage, /products, /pricing, /percival, /company, /llm-testing/llm-observability, the self-serve API announcement, the Series B announcement, the MCP server post, and the SDK quickstart/index on patronus-ai.github.io. docs.patronus.ai returned 401 on every path. A negative cannot be sourced, so the cell is kept and flagged.

rows.vendor: Patronus MCP server (evaluate, batch_evaluate, custom_evaluate, run_experiment, create_criteria); API key required
rows.quote: Create an account at https://app.patronus.ai and grab an API key. You need this because the Patronus MCP Server is interacting with the Patronus API under the hood.

rows.vendor: Proprietary platform with usage-priced API; Lynx and GLIDER model weights released as open source / open weights

rows.quote: Developers can also access a web dashboard to track and filter Patronus API logs, compare AI product performance snapshots, and experiment with different LLM systems.

faq.question: What is the difference between Iris and Patronus AI?
faq.vendorPart: Patronus AI now describes itself as 'Simulating the World's Intelligence' — developing simulation research and infrastructure (Digital World Models) toward human-aligned AGI — while still offering its evaluation models Lynx (hallucination detection) and GLIDER, Percival for agent-trace debugging, and a usage-priced evaluation API with a Python SDK and an MCP server.

faq.question: Is Iris or Patronus AI better for detecting hallucinations?
faq.vendorPart: Patronus AI's Lynx is a fine-tuned hallucination detection model that the vendor says 'outperforms GPT-4o, Claude-3-Sonnet and closed and open-source LLM-as-a-judge models'; GLIDER scores text against user-defined criteria with reasoning chains.
